description: 県有農業用ダム・ため池一覧 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences and irrigation] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 熊本県. 県が所有する農業用ダム・ため池の一覧です。. Coverage: 熊本県. The portal files it under the publisher 熊本県. Its tags are 農林水産部. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2025-01-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
